description.value: The Cowichan Community Centre Sports Complex is a major public recreation facility in Duncan operated by the Cowichan Valley Regional District. It offers swimming and ice hockey as its primary sports, making it one of the larger community recreation hubs on Vancouver Island's mid-section. Touring cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley may find it a useful stop for post-ride recovery.
